Class TrustedSources

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup.TrustedSources
@Internal public final class TrustedSources extends Object
The trust rule for the switches that enable fault injection or a management endpoint, for the Quarkus and Micronaut integrations (Spring decides with its own property sources).

Plan authors are trusted; a switch is honoured only when the config source it comes from is a launch-time local one (system properties, environment variables, the application's own config files), unless "macstab.chaos.allow-remote-enable" itself comes from such a source. A remote config server therefore cannot switch chaos on. A switch from any other source, including a source a future framework release renames, is ignored (fails closed) with one log line naming the source. Booleans accept true|false|1|0|yes|no|on|off; any other value leaves the switch off with one warning.

    • switchedOn

      public static boolean switchedOn(String property, Function<String, @Nullable TrustedSources.Sourced> lookup, Predicate<String> trusted)
      Whether a switch is on: its value is true and comes from a trusted source, or "macstab.chaos.allow-remote-enable" is true and comes from one. A lookup that fails counts as an untrusted source.
      Parameters:
      property - the switch
      lookup - finds a setting's value and source; null when the setting is absent
      trusted - whether a source is launch-time local
      Returns:
      true when the switch is on
